# Report for `r params$countries`

The aim of this report is to show the extracted data for `r params$countries`.

```{r setup,  include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  cache.lazy = F,
  bitmapType = "cairo"
)
Sys.setlocale("LC_ALL", "C")
```

```{r preamble}
library(tidyverse)
library(magrittr)
library(ggthemes)
library(kableExtra)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(gtsummary)
library(cowplot)
source(here("Analysis/utils.R"))

theme_gtsummary_compact(set_theme = TRUE, font_size = 13)
```


```{r data}

# Update
dat <- readRDS(here("generated_data/processed_estimate_data.rds"))

if (params$countries == "all") {
  this_countries <- unique(unlist(dat$country_list))
} else if (params$countries %in% c("Africa", "Asia", "Other")) {
  dat <- readRDS(here("generated_data/processed_estimate_data.rds"))
  this_countries <- unique(unlist(dat$country_list[dat$continent == params$countries]))
}  else {
  this_countries <- str_split(params$countries, ",") %>% .[[1]]
}

# All estimates
est_data <- readRDS(here("generated_data/processed_estimate_data.rds")) %>% 
  filter(map_lgl(country_list, function(x) any(map_lgl(this_countries, ~ . %in% x)))) %>% 
  mutate(studykey = iconv(studykey, from="LATIN1", to ="ASCII")) %>% 
  mutate(a_class = case_when(str_detect(a_class, "corr") ~ "correlation",
                             str_detect(a_class, "log10_ratio") ~ "log10_ratio",
                             str_detect(a_class, "risk difference") ~ "risk difference",
                             TRUE ~ "other"))

# Metadata on extracted papers
metadata <- readxl::read_excel(here("Data/extracted_data/cholera_climate_systematic_review_extract_into_sheets.xlsx")
                               , sheet = "metadata_0329") %>% 
  filter(remove_keep == "keep") %>% 
  filter(studykey %in% est_data$studykey) %>% 
  arrange(studykey)

# Shapefiles
# shapefiles <- readRDS(here("Data/shapefiles/location_shapefiles.rds"))  %>% 
#   filter(studykey %in% est_data$studykey)

```

```{r data-processing}

# Compute time bounds
est_timings <- est_data %>% 
  group_by(studykey, continent, eff_loc, admin_level) %>% 
  summarise(tl = min(eff_tl, na.rm = T),
            tr = max(eff_tr, na.rm = T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(dt = as.numeric(difftime(tr, tl, units = "days")))  %>% 
  group_by(studykey) %>% 
  mutate(min_tl = min(tl)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(studykey = factor(studykey) %>% 
           forcats::fct_reorder(min_tl)) %>% 
  filter(tl > "1900-01-01") %>% 
  mutate(eff_loc = ifelse(is.na(eff_loc), "", eff_loc),
         uid = str_c(studykey, eff_loc, sep = "-"))
```


## Papers
There are `r nrow(metadata)` papers that cover `r params$countries`.

```{r papers-descriptive}
metadata %>% 
  select(studykey, citation, title, pubyear, country) %>% 
  kbl(booktabs = T) %>% 
  kable_styling(full_width = F, font_size = 12) %>% 
  scroll_box(
    height = "500px",
    box_css = "border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 5px; ",
    fixed_thead = TRUE
  )

```

```{r fig-timings}
#| fig.width=8,
#| fig.height=4,
#| fig.cap='Time coverage of studies'

colors_admin_lev <- function() {
  c("regional" = "blue", "national" = "green", "sub-national" = "black")  
}

pd <- ggstance::position_dodgev(height = .2)

est_timings %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = studykey, color = admin_level, group = uid)) +
  geom_point(aes(x = tl), position = pd) +
  geom_point(aes(x = tr), pch = 2, position = pd) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = tl, xmax = tr), position = pd) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_admin_lev()) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "5 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "study time", title = "Study timings") 
```

## Estimates

There are `r nrow(est_data)` estimates that cover `r params$country`.

### Estimate type descriptives

Descriptive table of estimate characteristics.

```{r estimates-descriptive}

# Summary table of estimates
est_data %>% 
  select(exp_class, exp_temp_scale, exp_spatial_scale, out_class_metric, a_class, urban_rural_class, lag_class, rainy_season, 
         inland_coast, hdi_cat, new_climatic_zone, admin_level) %>% 
  # Drop missing levels in admin_level to simplify table
  mutate(admin_level = forcats::fct_drop(admin_level)) %>% 
  tbl_summary(by = "admin_level") %>%
  modify_table_body(
    mutate,
    groupname_col = case_when(str_detect(variable, "exp_") ~ "Exposure",
                              str_detect(variable, "out_") ~ "Outcome",
                              str_detect(variable, "a_") ~ "Association measure",
                              TRUE ~ "Covariate")
  ) %>% 
  modify_caption("Characteristics of association measures")
```

### Estimate value descriptives

Descriptive table of estimate values.

```{r estimates-values-descriptive}

# Summary table of estimates
est_data %>% 
  mutate(a_uncert_value = as.character(a_uncert_value)) %>% 
  select(exp_class, out_class_metric, a_class, a_effect, a_direction, a_uncert_significant) %>% 
  tbl_strata(
    strata = c("exp_class"), 
    .combine_with = "tbl_stack",
    ~.x %>%
      tbl_strata(
        strata = c("out_class_metric"),
        ~.x %>%
          tbl_summary(
            by = a_class,
            type = where(is.numeric) ~ "continuous"
          ) %>%
          modify_header(all_stat_cols() ~ "**{level}**")
      )
  ) %>% 
  modify_caption("Value of association estimates by exposure class and outcome type")
```

### Estimate direction

```{r fig-estimate-direction}
#| fig.width=8,
#| fig.height=5,
#| fig.cap='Direction of estimates.'

est_data %>% 
  correct_effect(thresh = 0) %>%
  filter(!(a_direction %in%  c("not stated", "none"))) %>% 
  define_stat_significance() %>% 
  simplify_direction_levels() %>% 
  make_direction_counts(vars = c("exp_class", "admin_level")) %>% 
  plot_direction_by_var(x_var = "admin_level", 
                        do_facet = TRUE,
                        facet_formula = ~ exp_class,
                        facet_scales = "fixed")
```

### Estimate forest plot

Plot values of estimates by type and exposure.

```{r fig-estimate-forest}
#| fig.width=11,
#| fig.height=30,
#| fig.cap='Forest plot of estimate values'

forestplot <- function(df) {
  
  if (df$a_class[1] == "correlation") {
    xlims <- c(-1, 1)
  } else {
    xlims <- c(-2, 2)
  }
  
  df %>% 
    mutate(uncertainty_missing = is.na(a_uncert_value) & is.na(a_uncert_lb)) %>% 
    group_by(studykey) %>% 
    mutate(rid = str_c(studykey, row_number(), sep = "-")) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = a_effect, color = admin_level, alpha = uncertainty_missing)) +
    geom_point(aes(y = rid)) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(y = rid, xmin = a_uncert_lb, xmax = a_uncert_ub), height = .2) +
    geom_vline(data = tibble(x = 0), aes(xintercept = x), lty = 2, lwd = .5) +
    ggh4x::facet_nested(out_class_metric + studykey ~ ., scales = "free", space = "free", switch = "y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors_admin_lev()) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c(1, .25)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xlims) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "white"),
          panel.border = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          axis.line.y = element_blank(),
          axis.line.x = element_line())
}

all_fplots <- est_data %>% 
  correct_effect(thresh = 0) %>%
  filter(a_class %in% c("correlation", "log10_ratio")) %>% 
  group_by(exp_class) %>% 
  group_map(function(x, y) {
    x <- bind_cols(x, y)
    pl <- map(unique(x$a_class), 
              function(.x) {
                x %>% 
                  filter(a_class == .x) %>% 
                  forestplot() +
                  labs(title = .x, x = .x) +
                  # guides(color = "none") +
                  theme(title = element_text(size = 9)) +
                  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
                        axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
              })
    
    plot_grid(
      plotlist = list(ggdraw() +
                        draw_label(x$exp_class[1], fontface = "bold", size = 16), 
                      plot_grid(plotlist = pl, 
                                nrow = 1)
      ),
      ncol = 1, 
      rel_heights = c(0.2, 1))
  })


plot_grid(plotlist = all_fplots, 
          ncol = 1)
```
